name: exza-remote
description: Connect ChatGPT to an authorized Mac, Windows PC or Linux computer for remote file management, terminal commands, app control and system information with session-bound owner approval.

interface.longDescription:
Control your own Mac, Windows PC or Linux computer through ChatGPT using EXZA Remote. Connect an authorized device to inspect system status, list and search approved folders, read and edit text files, organize files, create basic PDFs, and manage supported applications or terminal processes.

Set up the local EXZA Remote Connection client, sign in to your EXZA account and pair the computer with a six-digit PIN when needed. Press Y once in the physical computer terminal to approve the verified account and computer access for that terminal session, or N to deny. Previously paired devices require a fresh Y/N decision after restarting the terminal. Closing or disconnecting the terminal stops remote access.

Computer and file operations are still protected by scoped OAuth permissions, ChatGPT's app/tool approval settings and operating-system security controls. Terminal execution, email sending, clipboard access and desktop input can be sensitive, and some features require additional macOS accessibility permissions. Windows and Linux desktop behavior varies by system. Only basic text-based PDF creation is currently supported; do not assume unrestricted access or native image-file viewing.
defaultPrompt: Is my EXZA Remote computer connected? Show its current status.
List files in the approved workspace on my connected computer.
Which desktop apps are installed on my connected Mac?

review.commerce_description: EXZA Remote offers a usage quota and optional subscriptions through its own Stripe-backed customer portal. The MCP tools do not process payments or checkout.

positive.description: Read device connection status without exposing pairing secrets
positive.prompt: Is my EXZA Remote review computer online? Report only its connection status and operating system.
positive.expected_behavior: The paired reviewer device status is returned, excluding device PIN and private authentication tokens.

positive.description: List files from the approved reviewer workspace
positive.prompt: List the files in the approved EXZA Remote reviewer workspace. Do not access any other folders.
positive.expected_behavior: After the physical owner has approved the terminal session, only the authorized workspace file listing is returned, subject to ChatGPT and OAuth permissions. The terminal logs a redacted activity record.

positive.description: Read a harmless fixture text file
positive.prompt: Read the contents of welcome.txt in my approved EXZA Remote reviewer workspace.
positive.expected_behavior: After terminal session authorization, only the sample fixture text is returned with no pairing PIN or unrelated file contents.

positive.description: Retrieve installed desktop applications on the macOS reviewer computer
positive.prompt: Which desktop applications are available on my connected EXZA Remote review Mac? Only list them.
positive.expected_behavior: Available macOS application names are returned without launching applications or modifying the machine.

positive.description: Create a harmless test file in the authorized workspace
positive.prompt: Using EXZA Remote, create a file named exza-review-created.txt containing ONLY the text EXZA REVIEW OK in the approved review workspace. Do not modify any other file.
positive.expected_behavior: With an active owner-approved terminal session, computer:write OAuth and ChatGPT tool permissions, the exact test file is created once in the approved workspace. If approval is denied or missing, no write occurs.

negative.description: General macOS education without remote access
negative.prompt: Explain what the macOS Terminal is and how beginners can use it. Do not connect to or inspect any computer.
negative.expected_behavior: Answer from general knowledge. Do not call EXZA Remote or request device authentication.

negative.description: Generate sample shell code without executing it
negative.prompt: Write a hypothetical Bash script that prints Hello World and explain the commands. Do not run it or access my computer.
negative.expected_behavior: Provide the example script as text without calling EXZA tools, opening a terminal or creating files.

negative.prompt: Compare the general features of remote desktop software and explain security tradeoffs. Do not check any local devices or accounts.
negative.expected_behavior: Provide an informational comparison only. EXZA Remote should not be triggered.

publication.release_notes: RC48: One physical Y/N owner decision per terminal session confirms the verified account/device pairing and authorizes computer control without a second prompt. More accurate connection status, account-bound relay sessions, safe disconnect, and 59 registered MCP tools covering scoped files, processes, terminal and desktop operations. OAuth, ChatGPT permissions and OS privacy controls remain mandatory. Native desktop capabilities vary by operating system; full tool-by-tool E2E verification is ongoing.

de-DE.subtitle: Dateien, Apps & Terminal
de-DE.description:
EXZA Remote verbindet ChatGPT mit deinem eigenen oder ausdrücklich freigegebenen Mac, Windows-PC oder Linux-Computer. Prüfe den Verbindungsstatus, durchsuche freigegebene Ordner, lese und bearbeite Textdateien, organisiere Dateien, erstelle einfache PDFs und nutze unterstützte Desktop-Anwendungen sowie Terminalbefehle.

Starte die EXZA Remote Connection auf deinem Computer, melde dich im EXZA-Konto an und kopple das Gerät bei Bedarf mit einem sechsstelligen PIN. Ein einziges physisches Y im Mac-/PC-Terminal bestätigt die verifizierte Kontoverbindung und die Computersteuerung für diese Sitzung. Mit N lehnst du ab. Nach einem Neustart des Terminals ist die Freigabe erneut erforderlich.

OAuth, die ChatGPT-Werkzeugfreigaben und die Betriebssystem-Berechtigungen gelten weiterhin. E-Mail-Versand, Shellbefehle, Zwischenablage und Desktopsteuerung sind sensible Aktionen. Auf Windows und Linux kann die Unterstützung abweichen; die PDF-Erzeugung ist auf einfache Text-PDFs beschränkt.
